values.note: Three State Forest sites (Manny Gordon 001-003) on a loop behind the picnic area of the Manny Gordon Recreation Area off Thornhurst/Bear Creek Road. Each lists a 16-ft max vehicle length and 'suitable for tents and pop-up trailers'; 001 is a parallel pull-off with a 25-ft gravel driveway, 002 and 003 back-in with 20-22 ft driveways. Limited to 2 vehicles, or one vehicle and one wheeled camping unit.

summary: Confirmed reservable on ReserveAmerica 11 months ahead to noon, 7-night limit, $10 resident rate as recorded. Added no hookups/water/dump/showers, non-flush toilet over 300 ft away, 3 sites each listed at a 16-ft max vehicle length (tents and pop-ups), reservation required (fcfs never), closed Nov 15 - Apr 1. AWH note left as is (still accurate). Fees left at the DCNR state forest rate.
